_about: D1 band-state cases, shared by web/test/bandstate.test.mjs and, when rendering contract v1.7 lands its section 11.9 Tonight line, by the Python renderer. `now` is UTC; the band reasons in America/New_York. `expect` is the state bandState() must return for that day's real slate.

cases.name: CFB Saturday, 09:00 ET - before the 12:00 window
CFB Saturday, 13:30 ET - inside the window
CFB Saturday, 23:59 ET - past the last block, so Finals
cases.note: The last CFB kickoff is 19:30 and its block closes at 23:00, so by 23:59 the day is over. The first draft of this fixture expected 'live' on the assumption that the window ran to midnight; it does not, and the code was right.
